The president of Germany , officially titled the federal president of the Federal Republic of Germany (German: Bundespräsident der Bundesrepublik Deutschland ), [ 2 ] is the head of state of Germany . The current officeholder is Frank-Walter Steinmeier who was elected on 12 February 2017 and re-elected on 13 February 2022. He is currently serving his second five-year-term, which began on 19 March 2022.
